name: Union-Find (DSU)
description: Disjoint Set Union data structure supporting near-constant-time union and find operations using path compression and union by rank.
aim: Maintain a partition of elements into disjoint sets, supporting efficient union (merge two sets) and find (which set contains an element) operations.
howItWorks: Initialize each element as its own set (parent[i]=i, rank[i]=0)
Find(x): follow parent pointers to root; apply path compression (parent[x]=root)
Union(x,y): find roots of x and y; attach shorter tree under taller (rank)
Path compression makes future finds faster
Union by rank keeps tree shallow — O(log n) depth

time.averageCase: α is inverse Ackermann — effectively O(1)

complexity.spaceDescription: Parent and rank arrays — one entry per element

realWorld: Kruskal's MST algorithm — detect cycle before adding edge
Network connectivity — are two nodes connected?
alternatives: Spanning tree algorithms — for specific MST problems
Link-cut trees — for dynamic graphs with deletions
